# Microsoft

> > Microsoft's official website covering AI-powered productivity tools, cloud computing, Windows operating systems, Xbox gaming, Surface devices, and enterprise solutions.

Microsoft is a global technology leader offering products and services spanning consumer software (Microsoft 365, Windows 11), hardware (Surface, Xbox), cloud infrastructure (Azure), AI innovation (Copilot), and family safety tools. The site serves as the primary hub for product information, purchasing, support, and corporate resources.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft 365
- Windows 11
- Microsoft Copilot
- Copilot+ PC
- Xbox Series X
- Surface Laptop
- Surface Pro
- Microsoft Family Safety
- Microsoft Edge
- AI and machine learning
- Cloud computing
- Digital safety and parental controls
- Gaming and entertainment
- Productivity software
- Device management

## Core Platform & Products

- [Microsoft – AI, Cloud, Productivity, Computing, Gaming & Apps](http://go.microsoft.com/): Main homepage featuring Microsoft 365, Copilot, Xbox, Windows, and Surface

## Family & Digital Safety

- [Microsoft Family Safety | Microsoft 365](http://family.microsoft.com/): Family Safety product page for parental controls and digital safety tools
